units: <cite ref="Beitzah 14b:3">Bets. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>חזייה דהוה קליף צִהֲרֵיה</he> he saw that its appearance was that of a recently peeled object (v. <cite ref="R00143"><he>צְהַר</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: a clear, translucent liquid, as oil, brine &c.
units: Kidd. 48ᵇ הא בחמרא הא בצ׳ in the one case, it means a cup filled with dark wine, in the other a cup filled with a translucent liquid (which allows the cup containing it to be examined and valued).—[Bekh. 40ᵃ צ׳ R. Ḥan.: the red ring surrounding the dark of the eye; ed. חיורא; Nidd. 23ᵃ צִירְיָא, q. v.].
